text:
sasha: Need a final benchmark narrative for next week's launch. One headline, three charts (P95 focus), and short X copy. Can eng confirm the numbers today?

miguel: Audience is infra/ML engineers. Keep SLO language front-and-center; cost metric should be $/100k tokens for headlines.

anya: Chart set: 1) P95 latency vs throughput (highlight matched-P95 points), 2) cost per 100k tokens (hosted vs dedicated vs baseline), 3) tail-latency heatmap. Simple labels, P95 callout.

tom: Running a quick sweep now. Test matrix: redwood-4b-fp16 + redwood-4b-q8, seq=256, batch=4 and 8. Will post CSV. ETA 30m.

benchbot: Job queued by tom. Tracker: https://redwood.share/bench/launch-quick (read-only).

olivia: GTM asks: headline + 1-line value prop for landing, webinar CTA capturing avg tokens/min (for routing), and UTM params utm_campaign=bench_launch_q2&utm_source=social. SDR tag = "bench_estimate"; route to growth-sdr unless enterprise thresholds met.

miguel: For public copy, be conservative: "Lower per-token cost while meeting your latency SLOs." Add lab stat in blog with footnotes.

anya: Social X draft: "New: benchmarked inference that balances latency SLOs and lower per-token cost. See results + get a personalized estimate: [link] #inference #llm" (<=220 chars).

tom: Sweep done. Quick summary: redwood-4b-q8 shows ~1.5x lower infra cost at matched P95 for seq=256 batch=4 under lab pricing (GPU $3.10/hr, infra overhead 12%). CSV uploaded to tracker.

miguel: Good. Add footnotes: lab pricing, warmed runtime (KV cache), no cold-starts. Dedicated reserved capacity note: better long-run economics.

sasha: Draft landing blurb: "Redwood Inference: predictable latency SLOs and lower per-token cost across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." CTA: "Get estimate". Olivia will add short form fields.

olivia: I'll wire UTM + routing today and add tokens/min field. Routing rule: if avg tokens/min >5000 or monthly_tokens >10M, tag enterprise and route to enterprise-sdr.

sasha: Thanks — final steps: tom add methodology snippet to the slide, design produce the three chart variants, olivia+anya draft blog and landing. Internal review by 1600PT tomorrow. Flag risky claims here. :rocket:
